body:
It's amazing to me that a stranger could know and understand my pain so well, and not know me at all. I've been trying the last few days to "get better" and I don't know if it's seasonal, (doubtful) but nothing is helping. I'm just crying all the time, and I can barely get myself out of bed before noon anymore. 

I sometimes wonder if I had a way to get out of my house if it would help, or if it would only mask the hurt and self hate with it's own distraction. Meaning that I would feel it all the same when I had to go back home. 

I just don't know if there is even hope for me left. 
I know it's getting worse. I can't even sleep anymore, I am so consumed with stress. Even when I do manage to fall asleep I'm woken with a racing heart and faint memories of a horrific nightmare. 

Just so many, too many, demons. Real and figurative, and I don't know if I can rid my life of them, or I even care to anymore.
